event_name: Date 04 September 2022 Time 19:13 2022 DUTCH GRAND PRIX 01 - 04 September 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Car 55 was approaching the pit position in an unsafe manner.
offence: Alleged breach of Article 34.14 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations.
reason: The Stewards heard from the driver of Car 55 (Carlos Sainz) and team representatives of Car 55 and Car 11 (Sergio Perez) and examined video evidence. The Stewards determined that the driver travelled very closely to the pit team of Red Bull Racing whilst approaching Scuderia Ferrari's pit position. Car 55 rear right wheel even touched one of Red Bull Racing wheel gun's air hoses. The Stewards further determined that the slight touch of the Red Bull Racing wheel gun's air hose was rather due to the configuration of Zandvoort pit lane which is particularly short. Therefore, no further action is taken.
rules_referenced: Article 34.14 of the FIA Formula One Sporting Regulations
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
title: Decision Car 55 Alleged Pit Lane Infringement
